fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) is currently trading at $258.31 and 24/7 Wall St. has a target price of $323.92, suggesting 25.4% upside with significant confidence and a BUY rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS delivered Q3 revenue growth of 39% to $45.98B, with anticipated growth of 40% or more in 2027–2028, and Graviton and Trainium customer commitments have increased more than 20-fold year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 capital expenditure surged 120.14% to $77.26B, though AWS enterprise customer commitments each increased more than 20-fold, and Amazon plans to begin selling Trainium outside AWS by end of 2027.
